As soon as I arrive, I change into my uniform, go through the security check, and then I check my email and the production plan for the day. At eight, my team has a short meeting where our leader tells us which models we're checking and whether there were any issues from the night shift. After that, I spend most of the morning on the line, inspecting product samples and recording the results in our system. Lunch is at noon in the company canteen, and that's usually the most relaxing part of the day, because I can chat with friends from other departments. In the afternoon, I do more inspections and sometimes help train new staff. Before I leave, I update my report so the next shift knows what's going on. Most days I finish at five, but when we have urgent orders, I stay a bit later.

I also helped update a few work instructions that were a little out of date. We had three meetings during the week. In the first one, our manager explained what the customer wanted to see, and in the other two, we checked our progress and practiced answering questions. On the day of the audit, I was nervous, but everything went smoothly, and the customer was satisfied. So in the end, all the late nights were worth it.

There's also a big window, so the room gets a lot of natural light in the morning. The kitchen is right next to the living room, and it has everything we need, like a fridge, a stove, and a microwave. Then there are two bedrooms and one bathroom. The bigger bedroom is for my wife and me, and the smaller one belongs to my daughter, and it's always full of toys. Those three days were really tough, because my daughter couldn't sleep well in the heat, so we put two fans in the bedroom and took cool showers before bed. These days, movies look so real, and I really respect the effort that goes into making them. For example, I love the Mission: Impossible series, because the main actor does a lot of his own stunts. On the other hand, I don't really enjoy slow romantic movies, because I usually fall asleep halfway through. So if I'm choosing a movie for myself, it's almost always an action movie.

They usually have nice decorations, air conditioning, and free Wi-Fi, so students often go there to study or work on their laptops. There are also a few big coffee chains in shopping malls. Most people thought that being healthy meant eating enough and being a little chubby, because food wasn't always easy to get. We were completely soaked within a few minutes. We quickly packed up everything we could and ran to our cars. Since it was too dangerous to stay, we decided to drive home in the middle of the night. It was a disaster at the time, but now we laugh about it. Since then, I always bring a raincoat.

These days, especially in big cities, more and more people live in apartments, because land is very expensive. New apartment buildings usually have modern facilities, like swimming pools, gyms, playgrounds, and security guards. The design of homes has also changed. Modern homes are more open, with the living room and kitchen in one big space, and they have large windows to let in natural light. Another big change is technology. Many new homes have smart devices, like smart locks, security cameras, and lights or air conditioners you can control with your phone. People also care more about saving energy, so some homes now use solar panels. In general, homes today are more comfortable and convenient than before.

questions.question_text: Housing is a topic that is often in the news. Tell me about what people in your country discuss when it comes to housing. Many young people say that even if they work hard for many years, they still can't afford to buy an apartment in the city. I remember a news story from last year about apartment prices in Hanoi. It said that the price of new apartments had gone up very quickly in just one year, much faster than people's salaries, which shocked a lot of people. The story explained that there weren't enough affordable apartments, while many new projects were luxury apartments. People reacted strongly on social media. Many complained that they would have to rent forever. The government also talked about building more social housing for low-income people. I think this is a serious problem that needs to be solved soon.

questions.sample_ih: When people rent a house or an apartment, they often face several problems. The first problem is the cost. Rent in big cities keeps going up, and sometimes landlords increase the rent suddenly, so renters have to move. The second problem is the quality of the place. Some rented rooms are small, old, and don't have good ventilation, and when something breaks, some landlords are very slow to fix it. Another issue is the contract. Some landlords don't give proper contracts, so it's hard for renters to get their deposit back when they move out. To deal with these issues, people usually look for places through trusted friends or apps with reviews, and they read the contract very carefully. These problems really affect where people live. Many young workers choose to live far from the city center, where it's cheaper, even though they have to spend more time commuting.

questions.sample_ih: I think one of the most useful home appliances these days is the robot vacuum cleaner. My family bought one last year, and it has made our life much easier. People consider it useful for several reasons. First, it saves a lot of time. You just press a button or use an app on your phone, and it cleans the floors by itself, even when you're not at home. For busy working people like me, that's really helpful. Second, it's smart. It can map the house, avoid furniture, and go back to charge itself when its battery is low. Some models can even mop the floor. Third, it's good for families with kids or pets, because it keeps the floor clean every day, not just on weekends. Some people leave trash on the grass or throw it into the lakes, which makes the parks dirty. There are also problems with maintenance. In some parks, the playground equipment is old or broken, which can be dangerous for kids. I think these problems are caused by fast urban development, a lack of funding, and some people's lack of awareness. To solve them, the city should plan more green spaces when building new areas, put more trash bins in parks, and run campaigns to teach people to keep parks clean.

questions.question_text: Compare the activities that children do at parks to activities that adults do while they are there. What are the differences? How are the facilities at parks for children and adults different?

questions.question_text: You indicated in the survey that you take vacations domestically. People say that traveling has become more difficult in the past 5 years. Tell me about the types of changes you have observed while traveling and talk about how these changes have affected travelers.

Hotels, flights, and food at tourist places are more expensive than before, especially during holidays, so traveling costs more for families. Another change is that popular places have become much more crowded. For example, places like Sa Pa and Da Lat are full of tourists on weekends, and the traffic on the way there can be terrible. On the other hand, some changes have made traveling easier. There are many more new highways, so it takes less time to drive between cities. Because of these changes, many travelers now plan their trips earlier, avoid traveling during peak holidays, and look for less famous places to escape the crowds.

During holidays, prices for flights and hotels can double, so many people worry about their budget. The second concern is overcrowding. Some people also complain about tourist traps, where sellers charge foreigners or tourists much higher prices. These problems are caused by many people traveling at the same time, a lack of regulation in some places, and the fast growth of tourism. To address them, the government and local authorities are trying to control prices during holidays and improve roads. Travelers are also learning to plan ahead, read reviews online, and travel during the off-season.

There are many low-cost airlines, so flights to countries like Thailand, Singapore, or Korea can be quite cheap if you book early. I think this trend is great, because it makes it easier for busy people like me to eat healthy even when we don't have time to cook at home.

questions.question_text: Gatherings and celebrations are important to people living in a city. However, the organization of these events takes time, energy and money. What are some issues people talk about related to organizing these events?

This news made a lot of people worried about street food safety. Afterwards, many people became more careful about where they buy food, and the local government started checking food stalls more often. I still eat street food, but I choose clean places.

I have a few ideas. First, there's another train that leaves at eleven tonight, so I could take that one and arrive early tomorrow morning. Second, if that train is full, I could take a sleeper bus tonight instead. Or third, if it's easier for you, I could come tomorrow afternoon, and we can just change our plans a little. Please let me know which option works best for you. Again, I'm so sorry. Talk to you soon.

questions.question_text: That’s the end of the situation. Have you ever traveled somewhere but missed a bus, a train or a plane? Tell me about when you had difficulty getting to your destination. Start by telling me where you were going and what exactly happened. And then, tell me what you had to do to get to your destination.

questions.sample_ih: Yes, I missed a flight once, and it was a really stressful experience. It happened about four years ago. I was going to Da Nang for my cousin's wedding. My flight was at seven in the morning, so I planned to leave home at five. But that morning, my alarm didn't go off, and I woke up at five thirty. I rushed out of the house and took a taxi to the airport, but there was traffic on the way. When I arrived, the check-in counter had already closed, and they wouldn't let me board. I was really upset, because the wedding was that evening. First, I went to the airline's ticket counter and asked about other flights. Luckily, there was a flight at noon, but I had to pay a fee to change my ticket. I arrived in Da Nang just in time for the wedding. Since then, I always set two alarms.

questions.sample_ih: Yes, I once bought a smartwatch that was different from what I expected. It was about a year and a half ago. Sometimes it counted steps even when I was sitting in a car. And the battery only lasted one day, not one week as advertised. I contacted the seller to return it, but they only offered a small refund. In the end, I kept it as a simple clock, and later I saved money to buy a better one.

questions.sample_ih: Yes, I had to cancel a trip at the last minute about two years ago. My friends and I had planned a three-day trip to Ha Long Bay. answer_sets.persona_vi: Nam, 32 tuổi, làm kiểm tra chất lượng ở một nhà máy điện tử, sống ở căn hộ với vợ và con gái 5 tuổi.
key_differences_vi: IM liệt kê thông tin bằng các câu ngắn đứng cạnh nhau.
IH nối ý thành đoạn, có lý do và cảm nhận, có một câu về thay đổi gần đây.
AL chia ý thành các phần rõ ràng và di chuyển qua quá khứ – hiện tại – tương lai có kiểm soát.
Độ dài tăng lên là hệ quả của việc phát triển ý, không phải mục tiêu.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Đừng học thuộc nguyên đoạn giới thiệu — câu 1 trong đề thật thường không được tính điểm nhưng giọng đọc thuộc lòng rất dễ nhận ra. Chỉ giữ thứ tự ý: ai – làm gì – sống với ai – thích gì – đang cố gắng điều gì.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Thay công việc, nơi sống, thành viên gia đình và sở thích bằng thông tin thật của bạn; chọn MỘT điều bạn đang thay đổi gần đây để kể.

IM.text: Hi, my name is Nam. I'm thirty-two years old. I live in Thai Nguyen with my wife and my daughter. I work at an electronics factory. My job is checking the quality of products. It is a busy job, but I like it. In my free time, I like watching movies and walking in the park near my house. On weekends, I usually take my daughter to the park because she loves the playground there. I also study English, because I sometimes use it at work. So, that's a little bit about me.
demonstrates: Đủ các ý cơ bản: tên, nơi sống, gia đình, công việc, sở thích
Câu đơn đúng ngữ pháp, thì hiện tại ổn định
Có một lý do đơn giản (because)
IM.next_level: Gộp các câu ngắn thành chuỗi có liên kết (which, so, but) và thêm một chi tiết hoặc ví dụ cho mỗi ý; thử thêm một câu về điều đã thay đổi gần đây (I've been…).

IH.text: Sure. My name is Nam, and I'm in my early thirties. I live in an apartment in Thai Nguyen with my wife and our five-year-old daughter. I work at an electronics factory, in the quality inspection team, so basically my job is to check products before they are shipped to customers. It can be stressful, especially when we have a lot of orders, but I like it because I learn something new almost every week. When I'm not working, I try to spend time with my family. We often take a walk in the park near our apartment after dinner, and on weekends we sometimes watch a movie together. Recently I've also been studying English in the evenings, because I need it more and more at work, and honestly, I'd like to feel more confident when I talk with foreign engineers. So that's a quick picture of me.
demonstrates: Các ý được nối thành đoạn mạch lạc
Giải thích công việc bằng lời của mình (basically…)
Có lý do và cảm nhận (stressful… but I like it because…)
Dùng hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn cho thay đổi gần đây
IH.next_level: Tổ chức rõ hơn theo từng mảng (cá nhân → công việc → ngoài giờ → mục tiêu) và kể ngắn một sự thay đổi theo thời gian (when I first started… now…), giữ đúng thì ở từng phần.

AL.text: Okay, let me tell you a bit about myself. My name is Nam, I'm thirty-two, and I live in Thai Nguyen, which is about an hour from Hanoi. I share a small apartment with my wife and our daughter, who just turned five, so our home is pretty lively most of the time. As for work, I'm in quality inspection at an electronics factory. My team checks finished products before they leave the plant, and if we find a defect, we have to trace where it came from and report it quickly. It's a job that takes a lot of patience, but I like that it trains me to notice details, even outside of work. When I first started, I mostly followed checklists, but over the years I've been given more responsibility, like training new staff. Outside of work, I'm a pretty simple person. I enjoy evening walks with my family, and I'm a big fan of action movies. Lately I've been putting more time into English, because I'd like to talk with our overseas partners more naturally. That's me in a nutshell.
demonstrates: Tổ chức theo các phần rõ ràng, chuyển ý mượt (As for work…, Outside of work…)
Kiểm soát nhiều khung thời gian: quá khứ (When I first started), hiện tại hoàn thành (over the years I've been given), tương lai/mong muốn (I'd like to)
Giải thích nhiệm vụ công việc chi tiết nhưng dễ hiểu
Có suy nghĩ cá nhân (it trains me to notice details)
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, mục tiêu tiếp theo là giữ chất lượng này qua nhiều câu hỏi liên tiếp và đan xen kể – tả tự nhiên hơn, thay vì xử lý từng phần riêng.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Người đi làm sống trong căn hộ 2 phòng ngủ ở thành phố cùng gia đình.
key_differences_vi: IM kể tên các phòng và đồ đạc.
IH dẫn người nghe đi qua căn nhà, có điểm thích/điểm trừ.
AL thêm lý do chọn nhà (quá khứ), bố cục chính xác, ưu – nhược và một mong muốn giả định.

answer_sets.personalize_vi: Vẽ nhanh sơ đồ nhà bạn trên giấy, rồi nói theo đường đi từ cửa vào. Dùng đúng số phòng, tầng, tiện ích thật quanh nhà.

IM.text: I live in an apartment in the city center. It's on the eighth floor. My apartment has two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, and one bathroom. The living room is not very big, but it has a sofa, a TV, and a small table. The kitchen is next to the living room. I like my bedroom because it is quiet and it has a big window. There is a supermarket near my building, so it is very convenient. I like my apartment very much.

Chuỗi câu miêu tả đơn giản, chính xác
Một lý do thích (because… so…)
IM.next_level: Dẫn người nghe 'đi' qua căn nhà theo thứ tự (When you walk in…), thêm chi tiết cảm giác (ánh sáng, không khí) và một điểm chưa hài lòng để câu trả lời có chiều sâu hơn.

IH.text: I live in an apartment on the eighth floor of a building near the city center. It's not huge, but it's comfortable and it suits my family pretty well. When you walk in, the first thing you see is the living room. We have a gray sofa, a coffee table, and a TV on the wall, and there's a big window, so the room gets a lot of natural light in the morning. The kitchen is right next to it. It's small, but it has everything we need, like a fridge, a stove, and a microwave. Then there are two bedrooms. The bigger one is ours, and the smaller one is my daughter's room, which is full of toys and drawings. What I like most is the location, because there's a supermarket downstairs and a park just five minutes away. The only downside is that the elevator gets really crowded in the morning. But overall, I'm happy living there.

Câu phức tự nhiên (which…, so…)

Đoạn văn liên kết, tròn ý

AL.text: Sure. I live in a two-bedroom apartment on the eighth floor of a fairly new building, about ten minutes from the city center. When we were looking for a place, location was our top priority, and I think we made the right choice, because there's a supermarket on the ground floor and a small park just across the street. The layout is pretty simple. You come in through a short hallway, and it opens into the living room and kitchen, which are basically one open space. That's my favorite part, actually, because I can cook and still keep an eye on my daughter while she's playing. We have a big window facing east, so the mornings are bright, although in summer it gets quite hot by noon. The two bedrooms are on the left side. Ours is simple, just a bed, a wardrobe, and a desk where I sometimes work, and my daughter's room is, well, a colorful mess most of the time. If I could change one thing, I'd want a small balcony for plants. Still, for a family of three, it's a very comfortable home.
demonstrates: Lồng bối cảnh quá khứ (When we were looking…) vào phần miêu tả hiện tại một cách tự nhiên
Miêu tả bố cục chính xác (layout, open space, facing east)
Lập luận ngắn: vì sao thích, ưu – nhược
Có câu giả định (If I could change one thing, I'd…)
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, tiếp tục giữ độ chính xác khi chủ đề chuyển sang trừu tượng hơn (ví dụ: giá nhà, xu hướng chung cư) và đan xen kể – tả mượt hơn.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Lớn lên ở quê trong nhà cấp 4, hiện sống ở căn hộ thành phố.
key_differences_vi: IM nêu được 'trước – nay' bằng vài tính từ so sánh.
IH kể kỷ niệm cụ thể và so sánh có cấu trúc 2 vế.
AL so sánh ở mức giá trị (tiện nghi vs. cộng đồng) và kết luận cân bằng, khung thời gian được kiểm soát chặt.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Câu chuyện cây xoài, bếp củi chỉ là ví dụ. Hãy dùng chi tiết thật của bạn — chính chi tiết riêng làm câu trả lời tự nhiên.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Liệt kê 3 thứ bạn nhớ nhất ở ngôi nhà cũ và 3 thứ tiện hơn ở nhà mới, rồi ghép thành cặp so sánh.

IM.text: When I was a child, I lived in a small house in the countryside with my parents and my grandparents. It had one floor and a big yard. There were many trees in the yard, and we had some chickens. I played with my friends there every afternoon. Now I live in an apartment in the city. It is more modern and convenient, but it is smaller and there is no yard. I miss my old house sometimes, but I like my apartment too.
demonstrates: Có cả quá khứ (lived, had, played) và hiện tại (live, is)
So sánh đơn giản (more modern, smaller)
Trả lời đủ hai phần của câu hỏi
IM.next_level: Thêm một kỷ niệm cụ thể ở ngôi nhà cũ (một lần…) và nêu ít nhất 2 điểm khác biệt có giải thích (vì sao khác, ảnh hưởng thế nào tới cuộc sống).

IH.text: When I was a kid, I lived in a one-story house in my hometown with my parents and my grandparents. It wasn't modern at all, but it had a big front yard with a mango tree, and that yard was basically my playground. I remember my friends and I used to play football there until it got dark, and my grandmother would shout at us to come in for dinner. Inside, the house was quite simple, just a living room, two bedrooms, and a kitchen at the back. Now I live in an apartment in the city, and it's really different. First, it's much more convenient. Everything is close by, and we have air conditioning and a washing machine, which we didn't have back then. But on the other hand, it feels a bit closed. There's no yard, and my daughter has to go to the park to play. So I'd say my old house had more space and more freedom, while my apartment is more comfortable.
demonstrates: Kỷ niệm cụ thể với used to / would — kể quá khứ có chiều sâu
So sánh có cấu trúc (First…, But on the other hand…)
Chuyển thì quá khứ ↔ hiện tại đúng chỗ
Kết luận tóm gọn sự khác biệt
IH.next_level: Giải thích sâu hơn nguyên nhân thay đổi (lối sống, công việc) và cảm nhận của bạn, giữ mạch so sánh xuyên suốt thay vì hai đoạn tách rời.

AL.text: The house I grew up in was a single-story brick house in a small village, and looking back, it shaped a lot of my childhood. Three generations lived under one roof, so it was never quiet, but I loved that. The most important part of the house wasn't even inside—it was the front yard. We had a mango tree there, and in summer my cousins and I would climb it, which drove my grandmother crazy. The house itself was basic. The kitchen was separate from the main building, and we used to cook with firewood until I was about ten. Compared to that, my apartment now is a completely different world. It's on the eighth floor, it has modern appliances, and I can get almost anything I need within five minutes. Practically speaking, it's much easier to live in. What I've lost, though, is that sense of community. Back then, neighbors would just walk into our yard to chat, whereas now I barely know the people on my floor. So if you asked me which one is better, I'd say my apartment fits the life I have now, but my old house gave me memories I wouldn't trade for anything.
demonstrates: Đan xen tả và kể trong quá khứ (would climb, used to cook, until I was about ten)
So sánh ở nhiều tầng: tiện nghi vs. cộng đồng
Từ nối so sánh tinh tế (Compared to that, whereas, What I've lost, though,…)
Kết luận có quan điểm cân bằng
AL.next_level: Duy trì cách lập luận này khi câu hỏi mở rộng sang xã hội (ví dụ: nhà ở Việt Nam thay đổi thế nào) và thêm số liệu/ví dụ cụ thể.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Người thích phim hành động, hay đi rạp cùng bạn bè cuối tuần.
key_differences_vi: IM kể đúng trình tự bằng câu quá khứ đơn.
IH có chi tiết sống động, nhận xét cá nhân và một thì phức tạp hơn.
AL đưa một biến cố vào câu chuyện, xử lý nó bằng ngôn ngữ phù hợp và vẫn giữ mạch kể rõ ràng.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không học thuộc chuyện 'bạn bị kẹt xe'. Học cách chèn MỘT điều bất ngờ nhỏ vào câu chuyện có thật của bạn.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Nhớ lại lần đi xem phim gần nhất của bạn: phim gì, đi với ai, một chi tiết vui hoặc phiền. Kể theo thứ tự trước – trong – sau.

IM.text: The last time I went to the movies was two weeks ago. I went with my best friend. We watched an action movie at a theater near my house. Before the movie, we bought popcorn and two cokes. The movie was very exciting, and the special effects were great. After the movie, we went to a small restaurant and ate noodles. We talked about the movie. I had a really good time that day.
demonstrates: Trả lời đủ: khi nào, với ai, xem gì, chuyện gì xảy ra
Thì quá khứ đơn chính xác
Trình tự trước – trong – sau
IM.next_level: Thêm chi tiết sinh động (tâm trạng, một khoảnh khắc trong rạp) và nối các sự kiện bằng từ nối thời gian đa dạng (while, as soon as, by the time).

IH.text: Actually, I went to the movies just last Saturday with my best friend, Long. We'd wanted to see the new action movie for weeks, so we booked tickets online on Friday night. On Saturday afternoon, we met at the theater about half an hour early, because Long wanted to get snacks. We got a large popcorn and two drinks, and then we found our seats in the middle row, which were perfect. The movie was really intense. There was a car chase at the beginning that was so loud that the whole room was shaking. To be honest, the story was a bit predictable, but the action scenes were amazing. After the movie, we were starving, so we went to a noodle place next door and spent almost an hour arguing about the ending. It was a simple day, but it was exactly what I needed after a busy week.
demonstrates: Kể chuyện có trình tự và chi tiết cụ thể
Dùng quá khứ hoàn thành (We'd wanted…) đúng chỗ
Có nhận xét cá nhân (a bit predictable, but…)
Kết có cảm nhận
IH.next_level: Thêm một tình huống nhỏ ngoài dự tính và cách bạn xử lý, đồng thời đan xen miêu tả (rạp, không khí) với lời kể mượt hơn.

AL.text: The last time was actually last Saturday, and it turned out to be more eventful than I expected. My friend Long and I had been waiting for the new action film for weeks, so we booked seats online the night before. The plan was simple: meet at six, grab some snacks, and watch the seven o'clock show. But when I got to the theater, Long called to say he was stuck in traffic because of a minor accident on the bridge. So I bought the popcorn, saved his seat, and kept texting him updates while the ads were playing. He ran in about ten minutes after it started, completely out of breath, and the guy next to us gave him a pretty annoyed look. As for the movie itself, the action scenes were incredible—there was a chase through a night market that had everyone on the edge of their seats—but the plot fell apart a bit toward the end. Afterwards, we went for noodles and ended up debating whether the ending made any sense. Even with the rough start, it was one of the most fun evenings I've had in a while.
demonstrates: Xử lý một biến cố trong câu chuyện (bạn bị kẹt xe) một cách tự nhiên
Kiểm soát thì: quá khứ tiếp diễn, quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn, quá khứ đơn
Tách bạch kể diễn biến và đánh giá phim (As for the movie itself…)
Kết nối kết thúc với toàn bộ câu chuyện
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, tập kể cùng kiểu chuyện này nhưng chuyển nhanh sang trình bày ý kiến (ví dụ: rạp chiếu bây giờ có còn đáng đi không).

answer_sets.persona_vi: Người bắt đầu thích nhạc từ thời cấp 2, gu nhạc thay đổi theo thời gian.
key_differences_vi: IM có mốc 'trước – nay' nhưng chưa có tiến trình.
IH kể theo giai đoạn và giải thích lý do thay đổi.
AL biến tiến trình thành câu chuyện có ý nghĩa cá nhân, tổng kết bằng một nhận định sâu.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không cần có anh trai hay K-pop. Điều cần học là cách chia mốc thời gian và giải thích vì sao bạn thay đổi.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Viết 3 mốc: lúc bắt đầu thích nhạc, một giai đoạn thay đổi, hiện tại. Mỗi mốc 1 chi tiết + 1 lý do.

IM.text: I first became interested in music when I was in middle school. My older brother had a lot of CDs, and I listened to them with him. At that time, I liked pop music, especially Vietnamese pop songs. I listened to music every day after school. Now my taste is different. I still like pop music, but I also listen to some acoustic and ballad songs, because they are relaxing. I usually listen to music on my phone when I drive to work.
demonstrates: Nêu được mốc bắt đầu và người ảnh hưởng
Có quá khứ và hiện tại
Một lý do cho sự thay đổi
IM.next_level: Mô tả quá trình thay đổi qua vài giai đoạn (in high school… after I started working…) và giải thích vì sao gu nhạc thay đổi theo cuộc sống.

IH.text: I think it all started with my older brother. When I was in middle school, he used to bring home CDs from his friends, and we would listen to them together in his room. Back then I was really into Vietnamese pop, and I knew almost every song on the radio. In high school, my taste changed a little, because my friends were listening to Korean pop, so I started following some K-pop groups too. After I started working, though, I found that I needed something more relaxing. My job can be stressful, so these days I mostly listen to acoustic music and ballads, especially on my way home. I still enjoy pop songs at parties or in the car with my family, but I don't follow the charts like I used to. So I'd say my interest in music hasn't really gone away, it has just become calmer.
demonstrates: Kể theo các giai đoạn với used to / would
Giải thích nguyên nhân thay đổi gắn với cuộc sống
Chuyển thì quá khứ → hiện tại rõ ràng
Câu kết tổng kết sự thay đổi
IH.next_level: Thêm một ví dụ cụ thể (một bài hát, một buổi diễn) làm điểm nhấn và dùng ngôn ngữ đánh giá tinh tế hơn về vai trò của âm nhạc.

AL.text: Honestly, I owe my love of music to my older brother. When I was about twelve, he had a little collection of CDs that he'd borrowed from friends, and he'd let me sit in his room while he played them. That's how I got hooked on Vietnamese pop. By high school, my taste had shifted, partly because of peer pressure, to be honest. Everyone around me was obsessed with K-pop, so I started following a couple of groups and even tried to learn their dances, which didn't go very well. The bigger change came after I started working. I noticed that loud, fast music actually made me more tense after a long shift, so I gradually moved toward acoustic stuff, ballads, and some instrumental music. Now music works almost like a reset button for me. On my way home, I put on a playlist and by the time I park, I feel like I've left work behind. I still enjoy upbeat songs when we have friends over, but I'd say music has changed from something I used to follow like a fan to something I use to take care of myself.
demonstrates: Câu chuyện có tiến trình rõ: tuổi nhỏ → cấp 3 → đi làm → hiện tại
Kiểm soát quá khứ hoàn thành (had shifted, he'd borrowed) và quá khứ đơn
Phép so sánh (like a reset button) và tổng kết có chiều sâu
Tự nhận xét, hài hước nhẹ (which didn't go very well)
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, mở rộng sang nhận định chung (âm nhạc ảnh hưởng tới người trẻ ra sao) mà vẫn giữ ví dụ cá nhân.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Hay đi bộ buổi tối ở công viên gần nhà cùng gia đình.
key_differences_vi: IM liệt kê những gì có trong công viên.
IH tổ chức miêu tả và quan sát sự thay đổi theo thời điểm.
AL dùng cấu trúc tương phản, có phê phán và đánh giá tổng thể.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không cần công viên có hồ. Học kỹ thuật miêu tả: tổng quan → từng khu → theo thời điểm → đánh giá.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Nghĩ đến công viên thật bạn hay đến: có gì ở cổng vào, ở giữa, ở cuối? Buổi sáng và tối khác nhau ra sao?

IM.text: I often go to a park near my apartment. It takes about five minutes to walk there. The park has a big lake in the middle and many trees around it. There is a running path and a small playground for children. In the morning, many old people do exercise there. In the evening, it is very busy because families come to walk and relax. I like this park because it is clean and the air is fresh.
demonstrates: Miêu tả vị trí và cảnh vật cơ bản
Có thông tin theo thời điểm (morning / evening)
Một lý do thích
IM.next_level: Sắp xếp miêu tả theo một trình tự (từ cổng vào → hồ → khu vui chơi), thêm âm thanh/không khí và điều bạn thích nhất kèm ví dụ.

IH.text: The park I go to most often is just a five-minute walk from my apartment, so it's almost like our backyard. It's built around a fairly large lake, and there's a paved path that goes all the way around it, about one and a half kilometers. Along the path there are big shady trees and some benches where people sit and chat. On one side of the lake there's a playground with slides and swings, and next to it there's an outdoor gym area with simple exercise machines. What I find interesting is that the park changes a lot depending on the time of day. Early in the morning, it's full of older people doing tai chi or jogging. In the evening, it gets crowded with families and young couples, and sometimes there are street vendors selling snacks. My favorite time is around sunset, when the lake looks orange and the air finally cools down.
demonstrates: Miêu tả có tổ chức theo không gian
Chi tiết cụ thể (khoảng cách, tiện ích)
Có quan sát và nhận xét (What I find interesting is…)
Đoạn văn trôi chảy với mệnh đề quan hệ
IH.next_level: Đưa thêm đánh giá (điểm cần cải thiện của công viên) hoặc một khoảnh khắc cụ thể bạn từng trải qua ở đó để câu trả lời có chiều sâu.

AL.text: The park I go to most is a neighborhood park about five minutes from my place, and over the past few years it's become a pretty big part of my routine. It's laid out around a lake, with a walking loop of maybe one and a half kilometers, so it's ideal if you want exercise without going too far. What makes it nice is the variety. On the north side there's a playground and a little outdoor gym, so that area is always noisy and full of kids. The south side, on the other hand, is much quieter, with old trees and benches facing the water, and that's where people go to read or just sit. The atmosphere really depends on the time. At six in the morning you'll see retirees doing tai chi in perfect lines, whereas by seven in the evening it's packed with families and food vendors. If I had to criticize something, I'd say there aren't enough trash bins, so on weekends the paths can get messy. Still, for a free public space in the middle of a busy city, it's honestly a gift.
demonstrates: Miêu tả theo cấu trúc tương phản (north side / south side, morning / evening)
Lồng quá trình (over the past few years it's become…) vào miêu tả hiện tại
Có đánh giá phê phán và kết luận cân bằng
Từ vựng chính xác (laid out, retirees, packed with)
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, áp dụng cùng kỹ năng khi được hỏi về vấn đề của công viên công cộng nói chung (kinh phí, an toàn, ô nhiễm).

answer_sets.persona_vi: Đi du lịch Sa Pa cùng gia đình, xe bị thủng lốp giữa đường đèo.
key_differences_vi: IM kể đủ khung sự cố – xử lý bằng câu đơn.
IH có cao trào, liệt kê khó khăn, cảm xúc của từng người.
AL thể hiện việc ra quyết định giữa các phương án và cách vượt qua một khó khăn phụ.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Câu hỏi 'sự cố khi đi du lịch' rất phổ biến — giám khảo nghe nhiều câu chuyện thủng lốp. Hãy dùng chuyện thật của bạn và giữ lại kỹ thuật: bối cảnh đẹp → sự cố → lựa chọn → hành động → bài học.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Nhớ một chuyến đi có trục trặc (lạc đường, mưa, mất đồ, trễ xe…). Ghi 1 câu cho mỗi phần trong khung trên.

IM.text: Last summer, I went to Sa Pa with my family by car. On the way, we had a problem. Our car got a flat tire on a mountain road. There was no repair shop near there. My wife and my daughter were worried. I had a spare tire in the car, so I changed it by myself. It took about thirty minutes. Then we continued our trip. We arrived at the hotel late, but everyone was safe. After that, I always check my car before a long trip.
demonstrates: Kể đủ: bối cảnh – sự cố – cách xử lý – kết quả – bài học
Thì quá khứ chính xác
Câu ngắn, rõ ràng
IM.next_level: Làm rõ cảm xúc và từng bước xử lý (đầu tiên… nhưng… cuối cùng…), thêm một khó khăn phụ trong lúc xử lý để thể hiện khả năng kể chuyện có biến cố.

IH.text: This happened last summer, when my family and I drove up to Sa Pa for a short vacation. Everything was going really well at first. The weather was nice and the views on the mountain road were beautiful. But about an hour before we reached the town, I heard a loud noise and the car started shaking. I pulled over and saw that one of the tires was completely flat. The problem was that we were on a narrow mountain road, there was no repair shop nearby, and my phone signal was really weak. My daughter started crying, so my wife tried to calm her down while I got the spare tire out of the trunk. I had never changed a tire on a slope before, so it was quite stressful, and it took me almost forty minutes. Finally, we got back on the road and reached the hotel after dark. We were exhausted, but at least everyone was safe. Since then, I always check the tires and the spare before a long drive.
demonstrates: Câu chuyện có cao trào và nhiều chi tiết
Liệt kê khó khăn (The problem was that…)
Quá khứ tiếp diễn, quá khứ hoàn thành dùng tự nhiên
Kết thúc có bài học
IH.next_level: Xử lý tình huống ở mức phức tạp hơn: nêu lựa chọn bạn đã cân nhắc (gọi cứu hộ hay tự sửa) và lý do quyết định, giữ mạch kể liền lạc.

AL.text: The one that comes to mind is a trip to Sa Pa last summer. We'd planned it for months, and the first part of the drive was perfect—clear skies, hardly any traffic. Then, maybe an hour before town, there was a loud bang and the car started pulling to one side. I managed to pull over on a narrow bend and found the rear tire completely shredded, probably from a sharp rock. That's when things got complicated. We had no signal, the nearest town was too far to walk with a five-year-old, and it was starting to get cloudy. I considered flagging down another car to ask for a ride to a garage, but that would have meant leaving my wife and daughter alone on the roadside, so I decided to change the tire myself. The trouble was, I'd only ever done it once, on flat ground. On a slope, the jack kept slipping, so I had to wedge rocks behind the other wheels before it felt safe. It took nearly forty minutes, and by the time we reached the hotel it was dark and pouring rain. Looking back, I'm actually glad it happened, because now I never start a long drive without checking the spare and carrying a proper toolkit.
demonstrates: Xử lý biến cố phức tạp: nêu các lựa chọn, cân nhắc, quyết định
Ngôn ngữ chính xác cho tình huống (pull over, jack kept slipping, wedge rocks)
Khung thời gian kiểm soát tốt (We'd planned, I'd only ever done it once)
Phản tư cuối câu chuyện
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, giữ chất lượng này khi kể nhanh hơn, ít ngập ngừng, và khi bị hỏi thêm câu theo sau (What do you do differently now?).

answer_sets.persona_vi: Lần đầu ra nước ngoài: đi Singapore với đồng nghiệp trong một chuyến công tác/tham quan.
key_differences_vi: IM liệt kê nơi đã đi và cảm nhận chung.
IH kể theo trình tự, có một kỷ niệm điểm nhấn và giải thích khái niệm lạ.
AL thêm nhận định văn hóa, so sánh ngầm với quê nhà và cho thấy chuyến đi thay đổi bản thân thế nào.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không học thuộc địa danh. Nếu bạn chưa đi nước ngoài, đừng bịa — trong Background Survey chỉ chọn chủ đề bạn có trải nghiệm thật.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Chọn chuyến đi thật của bạn; tìm 1 khoảnh khắc nhỏ (người lạ giúp, món ăn lạ, lạc đường) làm điểm nhấn.

IM.text: My first trip abroad was to Singapore about five years ago. I went with three of my coworkers. Before the trip, I was very excited and a little nervous. In Singapore, we visited Marina Bay and Gardens by the Bay. The city was very clean and modern. We also tried a lot of local food, like chicken rice. It was delicious. I remember the subway the most, because it was fast and easy to use. It was a great trip.
demonstrates: Trả lời đủ: đi đâu, với ai, làm gì, nhớ gì
Thì quá khứ đúng
Có cảm xúc và một lý do
IM.next_level: Kể có diễn biến (ngày đầu, một sự việc cụ thể) và so sánh nhanh với Việt Nam để câu trả lời phát triển hơn.

IH.text: My first trip abroad was to Singapore, about five years ago. It was actually a company trip, so I went with three coworkers from my department. I remember I was super excited, but also nervous, because it was my first time on a plane and I wasn't confident about my English. When we landed, the first thing I noticed was how clean and organized everything was. We took the subway to our hotel, and I was surprised that it was so easy, even for a first-timer. Over the next three days, we visited Marina Bay, Gardens by the Bay, and a few shopping malls. One evening we ate at a hawker center, which is like a big outdoor food court, and I tried chili crab for the first time. It was messy but amazing. What I remember most, though, is a small thing. I got lost one night and asked a stranger for directions, and she actually walked me to the station. That made me feel much more comfortable traveling abroad.
demonstrates: Câu chuyện có trình tự từ lúc đến tới các ngày sau
Giải thích khái niệm bằng cách diễn đạt khác (which is like a big outdoor food court)
Chọn một kỷ niệm cụ thể làm điểm nhấn
Chuyển cảm xúc trước – sau chuyến đi
IH.next_level: Đối chiếu trải nghiệm với Việt Nam và nêu chuyến đi đó thay đổi bạn thế nào, dùng ngôn ngữ phản tư chính xác hơn.

AL.text: My first trip abroad was to Singapore, around five years ago, and I still think of it as a turning point. It was a study tour organized by my company, so I traveled with three coworkers, none of whom had been abroad either, which made it both fun and slightly chaotic. I remember being more anxious about the airport than about the country itself, because I'd never flown before and kept worrying I'd miss an announcement. Once we landed, though, Singapore made everything easy. The signs were clear, the subway was spotless, and within an hour we'd figured out how to get to the hotel on our own. We spent three days visiting the usual places—Marina Bay, Gardens by the Bay—but what struck me most was how differently public space worked there. Nobody littered, people queued patiently, and the streets felt designed for pedestrians rather than motorbikes. The moment I'll never forget, though, was getting lost on the last night. My phone had died, and a woman I asked for directions ended up walking me ten minutes to the station. That small act completely changed how I felt about traveling alone. Since then, I've been to a few other countries, but that first trip gave me the confidence to go.
demonstrates: Kể và tả đan xen, có nhận định về văn hóa (how differently public space worked)
Kiểm soát thì đa dạng (had been, I'd never flown, we'd figured out)
Mệnh đề quan hệ phức (none of whom had been abroad)
Kết nối trải nghiệm quá khứ với hiện tại (Since then…)
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, luyện nói về chủ đề này ở góc độ xã hội (du lịch nước ngoài của người Việt thay đổi thế nào) với ví dụ cụ thể.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Nhân viên kiểm tra chất lượng làm ca ngày ở nhà máy điện tử.
key_differences_vi: IM kể đúng trình tự theo giờ.
IH thêm lý do cho từng bước và cảm nhận.
AL giải thích ý nghĩa công việc, phân biệt các tình huống và trình bày như người trong nghề nói với người ngoài.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không đưa tên dây chuyền, mã sản phẩm, số liệu hay quy trình nội bộ vào câu trả lời. Chỉ nói ở mức chung chung, đủ để người ngoài hiểu.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Ghi lại giờ giấc thật của bạn trong một ngày và 1 lý do cho mỗi bước.

IM.text: I usually start work at eight in the morning. When I arrive, I change into my uniform and check my email. Then I have a short meeting with my team. We talk about the plan for the day. After that, I go to the line and check products. At twelve, I have lunch in the company canteen with my coworkers. In the afternoon, I continue checking products and I write a report. I finish work at five, but sometimes I work overtime.
demonstrates: Trình tự rõ ràng theo giờ
Hiện tại đơn + trạng từ tần suất đúng
Đủ các phần của một ngày
IM.next_level: Giải thích một vài bước bằng chi tiết (họp nói về gì, kiểm tra như thế nào) và thêm cảm nhận/khó khăn để câu trả lời không chỉ là danh sách giờ giấc.

IH.text: My workday usually starts at around seven forty-five, a bit before the official start time, because I like to settle in first. As soon as I arrive, I change into my work uniform and go through the security check, which is pretty strict at our factory. Then I check my email and the production plan for the day. At eight, my team has a short morning meeting, where our leader tells us which models we're inspecting and if there were any issues from the night shift. After that, I spend most of the morning on the line, checking samples and recording the results. Lunch is at around noon in the canteen, and that's usually the most relaxing part of the day, because I can chat with coworkers from other departments. In the afternoon, I do more inspections, and before I leave, I update my report so that the next shift knows what's going on. Most days I finish at five, but when we have urgent orders, I sometimes stay until seven.
demonstrates: Mô tả quy trình kèm lý do (because…, so that…)
Liên từ thời gian đa dạng (As soon as, After that, before I leave)
Có cảm nhận (the most relaxing part of the day)
Nói về công việc mà không tiết lộ thông tin nội bộ
IH.next_level: Phân biệt 'ngày bình thường' và 'ngày đặc biệt', giải thích ý nghĩa của các bước, và nêu thử thách của công việc để mở rộng ngôn ngữ.

AL.text: Well, it depends a bit on the production schedule, but a typical day goes something like this. I usually get in around a quarter to eight, which gives me fifteen minutes to change, get through security, and look at the plan before things get busy. At eight sharp we have a stand-up meeting. It only lasts ten minutes, but it's important, because that's when we hear about anything that came up on the night shift and which models need extra attention. Most of my morning is spent on the line doing inspections. People sometimes imagine it's just looking at products, but a big part of it is actually recording data accurately, because if something goes wrong later, those records are how we trace the cause. Lunch is my break from all that—I usually eat with friends from other departments, and we mostly avoid talking about work. The afternoon is more mixed. I might be inspecting, helping train a new team member, or following up on a defect with the production team. Before leaving, I always update the handover report, since the next shift relies on it. On a normal day I'm out by five, but during peak season, staying until seven or eight isn't unusual.
demonstrates: Tổ chức theo phần, có câu mở định hướng (it depends… but a typical day…)
Giải thích ý nghĩa đằng sau công việc (those records are how we trace the cause)
Phân biệt ngày thường và mùa cao điểm
Dùng cấu trúc đa dạng (People sometimes imagine…, isn't unusual)
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, tập trả lời câu hỏi theo sau mang tính nhận định (Công việc này thay đổi thế nào? Điều gì khó nhất?) mà vẫn giữ ví dụ cụ thể.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Nhân viên OQC phát hiện lỗi lặp lại trên một lô hàng ở ca đêm (ví dụ chung, không thuộc công ty cụ thể nào).
key_differences_vi: IM kể đúng chuỗi sự kiện.
IH có bước ngoặt nhận thức và hành động cụ thể.
AL thể hiện lập luận nguyên nhân, cân nhắc lựa chọn dưới áp lực và rút ra bài học khái quát.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không dùng số liệu, tên khách hàng, model hay quy trình nội bộ. Giữ ví dụ ở mức chung như bài mẫu.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Nghĩ về một lần bạn phát hiện/giải quyết vấn đề ở nơi làm việc (không nhất thiết là lỗi sản phẩm). Lúc đầu bạn nghĩ gì, sau đó làm gì?

IM.text: I remember one time last year. I was checking some phones near the end of my shift. I saw a small scratch on the back of one phone. Then I checked more phones, and some of them had the same scratch. I told my team leader about it. He called the production team, and they checked the machine. They found the problem and fixed it. After that, we checked all the phones again. I felt happy because I found the problem early.
demonstrates: Kể đủ bối cảnh – phát hiện – báo cáo – kết quả
Thì quá khứ đúng
Cảm xúc + lý do ở cuối
IM.next_level: Thêm suy nghĩ của bạn lúc phát hiện (lúc đầu nghĩ gì, sau đó nhận ra gì) và các bước báo cáo cụ thể hơn.

IH.text: Sure. This happened about six months ago, during a night shift. We were doing the final inspection on a batch of phones, and everything looked normal at first. But when I checked one unit under the light, I noticed a very thin scratch near the camera. At first I thought it was just one bad unit, so I checked a few more from the same tray, and three of them had exactly the same mark. That's when I realized it wasn't an accident. I took photos, wrote down the serial numbers, and reported it to my team leader right away. He contacted the production line, and they found that one of the fixtures was slightly damaged. They replaced it that night, and we re-checked the whole batch. Honestly, I was nervous because the shipment was urgent, but in the end we didn't send any defective products to the customer, so I felt really proud.
demonstrates: Câu chuyện có bước ngoặt (At first I thought… That's when I realized…)
Liệt kê hành động cụ thể
Kết quả và cảm xúc rõ ràng
Từ vựng công việc dùng tự nhiên (batch, unit, fixture)
IH.next_level: Giải thích vì sao quyết định của bạn quan trọng và rút ra bài học khái quát; thêm áp lực/cân nhắc (gấp hàng vs. chất lượng).

AL.text: Yes, there's one case I still remember clearly. It was during a night shift last spring, and we were doing the final check on a batch that had to ship the next morning, so everyone was under pressure. Most units looked perfect, but on one of them I noticed a hairline scratch next to the camera. It was so faint you could only see it at a certain angle under the inspection light. My first thought was that it was a one-off, but something didn't feel right, so I pulled a few more units from the same tray, and sure enough, several had an identical mark in exactly the same spot. That told me it was probably coming from the process rather than from handling. Instead of just setting those units aside, I documented everything—photos, serial numbers, the time—and escalated it to my leader. It turned out a fixture on the line had a tiny burr on it. They swapped it out, we re-inspected the whole lot, and the shipment left only a few hours late. Looking back, the lesson for me was that a pattern matters more than a single defect, and reporting early saves everyone a lot of trouble.
demonstrates: Lập luận trong câu chuyện (That told me it was probably coming from the process…)
Xử lý tình huống có áp lực, nêu lựa chọn (Instead of just setting those units aside…)
Ngôn ngữ chính xác, diễn giải chuyên môn cho người ngoài hiểu
Bài học khái quát hóa
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, chuyển cùng chủ đề sang câu hỏi trừu tượng (vì sao chất lượng quan trọng với khách hàng) và giữ lập luận có ví dụ.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Người dùng smartphone cho cả công việc lẫn sinh hoạt.
key_differences_vi: IM liệt kê việc dùng điện thoại theo thời gian trong ngày.
IH chọn công dụng chính, giải thích và tự đánh giá.
AL khái quát vai trò của thiết bị, so sánh với quá khứ, phân tích ưu – nhược và kết bằng thay đổi có kết quả.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không cần học thuộc 'remote control for my life'. Học cách mở câu bằng một nhận định khái quát rồi chứng minh bằng ví dụ.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Mở phần 'thời gian sử dụng màn hình' trên điện thoại của bạn: 3 app dùng nhiều nhất là gì? Đó là câu trả lời của bạn.

IM.text: The technology I use most often is my smartphone. I use it all day. In the morning, I check the weather and the news. At work, I use it to read messages from my team. At lunch, I watch short videos. In the evening, I use it to pay bills and order food. I also call my parents on video. My phone is very useful, but sometimes I use it too much and I go to bed late.
demonstrates: Trả lời đúng: thiết bị nào, dùng thế nào trong ngày
Trình tự sáng – trưa – tối
Có nhận xét ưu/nhược đơn giản
IM.next_level: Chọn 2–3 công dụng quan trọng nhất và giải thích chi tiết (dùng app gì, vì sao tiện), thêm một so sánh với trước đây.

IH.text: Definitely my smartphone. I'd say I use it from the moment I wake up until I go to bed. My alarm is on my phone, so it's literally the first thing I touch in the morning. While I'm having breakfast, I usually check the weather and read a few news headlines. During the day, I mostly use it for messaging, because my team shares updates in a group chat, and sometimes I need to reply quickly. I also use it a lot for payments. These days, almost every shop accepts QR codes, so I rarely carry cash anymore. In the evening, I relax by watching videos or reading, and on weekends I video call my parents in my hometown. To be honest, I think I depend on it a little too much. Sometimes I pick it up without any reason, so recently I've started leaving it outside the bedroom at night.
demonstrates: Câu trả lời có trọng tâm, mỗi công dụng có lý do
Thông tin xã hội (QR codes, rarely carry cash)
Tự đánh giá và thay đổi gần đây (recently I've started…)
Đoạn văn liên kết tự nhiên
IH.next_level: Phân tích sâu hơn ảnh hưởng của thiết bị lên thói quen (tích cực/tiêu cực) và đưa ví dụ so sánh với vài năm trước.

AL.text: Without a doubt, it's my smartphone, and if I'm honest, it's become more of a remote control for my whole life than just a phone. In the morning it wakes me up, tells me whether I need a raincoat, and gives me a quick look at the news while I eat. At work, it's mainly a communication tool. Our team coordinates a lot through group chats, so if a problem comes up on another shift, I'll often hear about it on my phone before anyone tells me in person. The biggest change for me, though, has been payments. Five or six years ago I always carried cash, but now I pay for almost everything with QR codes, from coffee to electricity bills, and I can't remember the last time I went to an ATM. In the evenings it shifts to entertainment and family—I watch videos, and on Sundays I video call my parents so they can see their granddaughter. The downside is that it's very easy to lose time on it. I noticed I was checking it constantly without really needing to, so I've set a rule for myself: no phone in the bedroom. It's a small change, but I sleep noticeably better.
demonstrates: Câu mở mang tính khái quát (more of a remote control for my whole life)
Tổ chức theo chức năng, có so sánh quá khứ – hiện tại
Phân tích ưu – nhược, kết bằng hành động cụ thể và kết quả
Ngôn ngữ linh hoạt, tự nhiên
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, tập trả lời câu hỏi theo sau dạng vấn đề xã hội (nghiện điện thoại, an toàn thanh toán) với lập luận hai chiều.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Từng trải qua bão lớn khiến khu nhà mất điện, ngập đường.
key_differences_vi: IM kể sự kiện và hậu quả.
IH kể theo diễn biến, miêu tả sinh động và rút ra nhận xét.
AL đặt câu chuyện trong bối cảnh lớn hơn (sự chuẩn bị, cộng đồng, xu hướng thời tiết) với khung thời gian được kiểm soát.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không học thuộc câu chuyện bão. Học cách kể 3 giai đoạn (trước – trong – sau) và kết bằng một nhận định.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Nhớ một lần mưa lớn, nắng nóng, ngập hay rét đậm bạn từng trải qua; mỗi giai đoạn 1–2 chi tiết thật.

IM.text: A few years ago, there was a very big storm in my city. It rained very hard for two days and the wind was very strong. Many trees fell down on the streets. My building lost electricity for one day. We could not cook, so we ate bread and instant noodles. The roads were flooded, so I could not go to work. After the storm, people cleaned the streets together. It was scary, but my family was safe.
demonstrates: Kể đủ: sự kiện, ảnh hưởng, cách đối phó, kết thúc
Thì quá khứ và could not đúng
Chuỗi câu nguyên nhân – kết quả (so…)
IM.next_level: Kể theo diễn biến thời gian (trước bão – trong bão – sau bão), thêm hành động chuẩn bị và một chi tiết đáng nhớ.

IH.text: I'll never forget the typhoon that hit my city a couple of years ago. We had heard about it on the news for days, so we bought some food and water and charged all our phones the night before. When it arrived, it was much worse than I expected. The wind was so strong that our windows were shaking, and around midnight the power went out in the whole building. We just sat in the living room with a flashlight, and my daughter was really scared, so we told her stories to keep her calm. The next morning, the street outside looked like a disaster area. There were fallen trees everywhere, and some parts of the road were flooded up to my knees. I couldn't go to work for two days. What impressed me, though, was how people reacted. Neighbors who usually never talked helped each other move trees and clean up. It was a frightening experience, but it also made me realize how important it is to be prepared.
demonstrates: Diễn biến rõ: chuẩn bị – bão đến – hậu quả – phản ứng
Quá khứ hoàn thành (We had heard…) và cấu trúc so… that
Miêu tả sinh động (looked like a disaster area)
Rút ra nhận định
IH.next_level: Mở rộng sang bình luận (thời tiết cực đoan có thường xuyên hơn không, cộng đồng/chính quyền đã làm gì) và giữ kiểm soát thì khi chuyển sang nhận định hiện tại.

AL.text: The one I remember most vividly is the typhoon that came through a couple of years ago. What made it memorable wasn't only the storm itself, but how unprepared most of us were, even though we'd been warned. The forecast had been talking about it for days, so we did the basics—stocked up on water and instant noodles, charged our phones—but I don't think anyone in my building really expected it to be that intense. By about midnight, the wind was howling, the windows were rattling in their frames, and then the power cut out completely. My daughter was terrified, so my wife and I ended up camping in the living room with her, telling stories by flashlight until she fell asleep. The real shock came the next morning. Our street was blocked by fallen trees, the low part of the road was knee-deep in water, and the whole neighborhood had no electricity for almost two days. That said, it brought out the best in people. Neighbors I'd barely spoken to were out with saws and brooms, sharing food and helping older residents. Since then, our building has set up a group chat for emergencies, and personally, I take warnings much more seriously. It feels like these storms are getting stronger every year, so being prepared isn't optional anymore.
demonstrates: Câu mở định hướng ý nghĩa của câu chuyện
Kiểm soát khung thời gian chặt chẽ (we'd been warned, had been talking, By about midnight)
Chuyển từ kể sang nhận định xã hội (it brought out the best in people; these storms are getting stronger)
Kết nối quá khứ – hiện tại – tương lai
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, tập nói ngắn gọn hơn mà vẫn đủ lập luận khi câu hỏi tiếp theo hỏi về nguyên nhân biến đổi khí hậu hoặc giải pháp.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Kể về người bạn thân từ thời cấp 3.
key_differences_vi: IM tả người bằng các tính từ và một lý do.
IH chứng minh tính cách bằng một câu chuyện cụ thể.
AL kể tiến trình mối quan hệ, phân tích tính cách nhiều lớp và lý giải vì sao gắn bó.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không cần bạn thân có câu chuyện bệnh viện. Học cách 'nói tính cách → chứng minh bằng ví dụ thật'.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Chọn một người thật, ghi 2 tính từ và 1 kỷ niệm chứng minh cho mỗi tính từ.

IM.text: I want to talk about my best friend, Long. We met in high school, so we have been friends for about fifteen years. He is tall and a little thin, and he always wears glasses. He is very funny and kind. When I have a problem, he always listens to me and gives me good advice. Now he lives in Hanoi, so we don't meet very often, but we call each other every week. He is very special to me because he is like my brother.
demonstrates: Giới thiệu người, ngoại hình, tính cách, lý do đặc biệt
Hiện tại hoàn thành (have been friends) dùng đúng
Chuỗi câu đơn giản, mạch lạc
IM.next_level: Chứng minh tính cách bằng một ví dụ cụ thể (một lần anh ấy đã giúp bạn) để câu trả lời có kể và tả kết hợp.

IH.text: I'd like to talk about my best friend, Long. We were classmates in high school, and somehow we've stayed close for almost fifteen years, even though our lives are very different now. He's tall and skinny, and he's worn the same style of glasses since we were teenagers, which I always tease him about. In terms of personality, he's really easygoing and funny. He can make a whole table laugh in a few seconds. But what makes him special to me is that he's incredibly reliable. For example, a few years ago, when my father was in the hospital, Long drove two hours from Hanoi just to bring us food and keep me company. He didn't even tell me he was coming. These days he's busy with his own family, so we only meet a few times a year, but we still talk on the phone almost every weekend. I honestly think of him as part of my family.
demonstrates: Tả ngoại hình và tính cách có liên kết
Ví dụ cụ thể minh họa tính cách (For example, a few years ago…)
Chuyển hiện tại ↔ quá khứ ↔ hiện tại đúng
Kết thúc nêu ý nghĩa
IH.next_level: Phân tích sâu hơn vì sao tình bạn bền vững (điểm giống/khác nhau giữa hai người) và dùng ngôn ngữ miêu tả tính cách chính xác hơn.

AL.text: The person who comes to mind right away is my best friend, Long. We sat next to each other in tenth grade, and honestly, we didn't like each other at first. He was loud, I was quiet, and the teacher kept moving us around. But somewhere along the way that changed, and now it's been fifteen years. Physically, he hasn't changed much—tall, skinny, and still wearing the same thick glasses—but as a person he's grown a lot. On the surface he's the funny one in any group, the guy who keeps conversations going. What people don't always see is how dependable he is. A few years back, when my dad was hospitalized, Long drove two hours from Hanoi without telling me, just to drop off food and sit with me in the waiting room. He didn't make a big deal of it, which is so typical of him. I think the reason our friendship has lasted is that we balance each other out. He pushes me to be more open, and I'm the one who reminds him to slow down. These days we're both busy with work and kids, so we rarely meet, but we have a standing phone call on Sunday nights, and that's become a kind of ritual for both of us.
demonstrates: Câu chuyện có tiến trình quan hệ (at first… somewhere along the way… now)
Phân biệt bề ngoài và bản chất (On the surface… What people don't always see…)
Lý giải vì sao tình bạn bền (we balance each other out)
Từ vựng chính xác (dependable, standing phone call, ritual)
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, tiếp tục với câu hỏi so sánh hai người bạn hoặc chủ đề thảo luận về tình bạn ở tuổi trưởng thành.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Kể về Tết Nguyên đán ở Việt Nam.
key_differences_vi: IM liệt kê phong tục chính.
IH giải thích phong tục cho người ngoài và gắn với gia đình mình.
AL trình bày có hệ thống, phân tích ý nghĩa và nhận định sự thay đổi của Tết.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Câu hỏi về Tết rất phổ biến — đừng đọc một bài 'chuẩn' giống mọi người. Thêm thói quen riêng của gia đình bạn.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Gia đình bạn có phong tục gì riêng dịp Tết? Ngày mùng 1 bạn thường làm gì? Đó là chi tiết làm câu trả lời của bạn khác biệt.

IM.text: The most important holiday in Vietnam is Tet, the Lunar New Year. It is usually in January or February. Before Tet, people clean and decorate their houses. They buy peach flowers or kumquat trees. During Tet, families get together and eat traditional food, like banh chung. Children get lucky money in red envelopes. People also visit their relatives and go to the pagoda. Tet is very special because everyone comes back home to be with their family.
demonstrates: Nêu thời gian, hoạt động trước và trong Tết, ý nghĩa
Hiện tại đơn dùng đúng cho phong tục
Giải thích ngắn món ăn/đồ vật
IM.next_level: Giải thích các phong tục rõ hơn cho người nước ngoài (vì sao làm vậy), thêm trải nghiệm của gia đình bạn để câu trả lời sống động hơn.

IH.text: The biggest holiday in my country is definitely Tet, or the Lunar New Year. It usually falls in late January or February, and it's basically the Vietnamese version of Christmas and New Year combined. The preparation starts weeks before. People clean their houses from top to bottom, because they believe it sweeps away bad luck from the old year. Then they decorate with peach blossoms in the north or yellow apricot flowers in the south. One of the most important traditions is making banh chung, which is a square sticky rice cake with pork and green beans inside. In my family, we still wrap them together at my parents' house. On the first days of the new year, we visit relatives, give lucky money to the kids, and wish everyone health and success. What I love most about Tet is that no matter how far away people work, they try to come home. The roads are crazy, but the feeling of being together is worth it.
demonstrates: Giải thích văn hóa cho người ngoài hiểu (basically the Vietnamese version of…)
Lý do đằng sau phong tục (because they believe…)
Kết hợp thông tin chung và trải nghiệm gia đình
Đoạn văn có kết luận cảm xúc
IH.next_level: So sánh Tết xưa – nay hoặc khác biệt vùng miền, và trình bày ý nghĩa xã hội của Tết bằng ngôn ngữ chính xác hơn.

AL.text: In Vietnam there's no question that the most important holiday is Tet, the Lunar New Year. It moves every year because it follows the lunar calendar, but it's usually somewhere between late January and mid-February. For foreigners, I usually describe it as Christmas, New Year's, and Thanksgiving rolled into one, because it's about family, food, and a fresh start all at once. The run-up is honestly the busiest time of the year. Offices rush to finish everything, and at home people do a deep clean, partly for practical reasons and partly because there's a belief that you should sweep out the bad luck of the old year before the new one begins. Markets fill up with peach blossoms in the north and yellow apricot blossoms in the south, and in a lot of families, including mine, we still wrap banh chung together, which takes almost a whole day. The first three days of the year have their own rhythm. The first day is usually for the father's side of the family, the second for the mother's side, and the third for teachers or friends. Kids receive lucky money in red envelopes, and everyone tries to say only positive things. Even though Tet has become more commercial lately, I think its core—people traveling hundreds of kilometers just to sit down together for a meal—hasn't changed at all.
demonstrates: Giải thích văn hóa có hệ thống (giai đoạn chuẩn bị, ba ngày Tết, phong tục)
Phân biệt lý do thực tế và niềm tin (partly… and partly…)
Có nhận định về thay đổi (more commercial lately) và giá trị cốt lõi
Ngôn ngữ chính xác, mạch lạc
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, chuẩn bị cho câu hỏi tiếp theo về vấn đề dịp lễ (giao thông, giá cả, an toàn) và xu hướng đi du lịch dịp Tết.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Bỏ thói quen thức khuya, uống nước ngọt; bắt đầu chạy bộ buổi sáng.
key_differences_vi: IM kể có trước – sau.
IH kể quá trình nhiều bước, có khó khăn và kết quả.
AL trình bày chiến lược, lý do lựa chọn và bài học khái quát; khung thời gian được dẫn dắt rõ.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không đưa số liệu sức khỏe không có thật. Nếu không muốn nói về sức khỏe bản thân, có thể kể về một thói quen nhỏ (uống nước, đi bộ…).
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Một thói quen bạn đã thay đổi (dù nhỏ): trước đây thế nào, vì sao đổi, đổi thế nào, kết quả ra sao.

IM.text: Yes, I changed some habits for my health. Two years ago, I often stayed up late and I drank a lot of soft drinks. I was always tired and I gained weight. Then my doctor told me to change my lifestyle. So I started going to bed before eleven and I stopped drinking soft drinks. I also started jogging three times a week. Now I feel better and I have more energy. It was difficult at first, but now it is easy.
demonstrates: Có thói quen cũ – lý do – thay đổi – kết quả
Phân biệt quá khứ (often stayed up) và hiện tại (Now I feel)
Trả lời đúng trọng tâm
IM.next_level: Kể quá trình thay đổi (khó khăn tuần đầu, cách vượt qua) và so sánh trước – sau bằng ví dụ cụ thể.

IH.text: Yes, about two years ago I made a pretty big change. Back then, I used to stay up until one or two in the morning watching videos, and I drank at least two cans of soda every day. I didn't think it was a big deal until I had a health check at work and the doctor told me my blood sugar was a little high. That really scared me, so I decided to do something about it. First, I set a rule that my phone had to be off by eleven. Then I replaced soda with tea and water, which was honestly the hardest part, because I really missed the taste. A few weeks later, I started jogging around the park three mornings a week. The first month was tough. I was tired and my legs hurt all the time. But after about two months, I noticed a big difference. I fell asleep faster, I had more energy at work, and I lost almost five kilos. Now jogging is just part of my routine.
demonstrates: Kể quá trình theo các bước (First… Then… A few weeks later…)
Used to cho thói quen cũ, quá khứ đơn cho sự kiện
Có khó khăn và cách vượt qua
So sánh kết quả rõ ràng
IH.next_level: Phân tích vì sao thay đổi thành công (động lực, môi trường) và tổng kết bài học có thể áp dụng chung.

AL.text: Yes, and it was a change I probably should have made much earlier. Until about two years ago, my lifestyle was, let's say, not great. I'd regularly stay up past one watching videos, and I was drinking two or three cans of soda a day without really thinking about it. The wake-up call was a routine health check at work. The doctor told me my blood sugar was on the high side, and even though it wasn't serious yet, hearing that at thirty was a shock. Instead of trying to change everything at once, which I'd failed at before, I decided to tackle one habit at a time. The first was sleep. I started charging my phone in the kitchen, so I physically couldn't scroll in bed. Once that felt normal, I swapped soda for unsweetened tea, which was harder than I expected—the first two weeks I was honestly cranky. Only after that did I add jogging, three mornings a week. The difference has been bigger than I imagined. I sleep better, my energy at work is more stable, and my last check-up was completely normal. If there's one thing I learned, it's that small changes you can actually stick to work better than big promises.
demonstrates: Câu chuyện có chiến lược và lý do (one habit at a time… which I'd failed at before)
Kiểm soát khung thời gian và trình tự (Once that felt normal…, Only after that did I…)
Đảo ngữ tự nhiên (Only after that did I add…)
Bài học khái quát rút ra từ trải nghiệm
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, tập chuyển sang câu hỏi xã hội (quan niệm sức khỏe của các thế hệ) với lập luận và ví dụ.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Thích phim hành động và phim hoạt hình gia đình.
key_differences_vi: IM nêu sở thích và lý do đơn giản.
IH lập luận có cấu trúc, thừa nhận quan điểm khác, so sánh thể loại.
AL cho thấy lý do thay đổi theo thời gian, đánh giá có tiêu chí và kết luận có sắc thái.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không cần thích phim hành động. Học cấu trúc 'lựa chọn → lý do 1 → lý do 2 + ví dụ → so sánh → kết'.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Chọn thể loại bạn thật sự xem; nêu một bộ phim cụ thể và một lý do chỉ bạn mới có.

IM.text: I like action movies the most. I think they are very exciting. There are many fights and car chases, so I never feel bored. I also like the special effects, because they look very real. My favorite action movie series is Mission: Impossible. I watch action movies after work because they help me relax. Sometimes I watch cartoons with my daughter, and I like them too. But action movies are my favorite.
demonstrates: Nêu rõ lựa chọn và 2 lý do
Một ví dụ cụ thể
Câu kết khẳng định lại
IM.next_level: So sánh với thể loại khác để làm rõ 'vì sao hơn', và đưa ví dụ một cảnh phim/trải nghiệm xem phim cụ thể.

IH.text: I'm a huge fan of action movies. I know some people think they're just noise and explosions, but for me they're the perfect way to switch off after work. The first reason is the energy. When I watch a good chase scene, I'm so focused that I forget about everything else for two hours. The second reason is the effort that goes into them. These days, a lot of stunts are done by real people, and I really respect that. For example, in the Mission: Impossible series, the main actor does many of his own stunts, and you can feel the difference. I don't really enjoy romantic movies or slow dramas, because I usually get sleepy halfway through. That said, since my daughter was born, I've also started watching a lot of animated films with her, and some of them are surprisingly good. But if I'm choosing a movie for myself, it's going to be action every time.
demonstrates: Lập luận có cấu trúc (The first reason… The second reason…)
Thừa nhận quan điểm khác (I know some people think…)
So sánh với thể loại khác
Ví dụ cụ thể và sự thay đổi gần đây
IH.next_level: Phát triển lý do ở mức sâu hơn (giá trị nghệ thuật, xu hướng), và giữ lập luận hai chiều mượt hơn.

AL.text: If I had to pick one genre, it'd be action, although my reasons have changed a bit over the years. When I was younger, it was purely about excitement—the bigger the explosions, the better. Now what I appreciate more is the craft behind it. A really well-made action scene is almost like a dance. Everything has to be timed perfectly, and when the stunts are real rather than computer-generated, you can actually feel the risk. The Mission: Impossible films are a good example. The fact that the lead actor does so much himself makes those scenes much more gripping than a lot of CGI-heavy superhero movies. Another reason, honestly, is practical. After a long shift, I don't have the energy for a slow drama that makes me think about life, so an action movie lets me completely switch off. That said, I wouldn't say I only watch action. Since becoming a dad, I've watched more animated films than I can count, and some of them handle emotions better than most adult movies. So my answer is action for myself, animation with my family, and dramas only when I'm in the right mood, which isn't very often.
demonstrates: Lập luận có chiều sâu, so sánh quá khứ – hiện tại về lý do
Phép so sánh hình ảnh (almost like a dance)
Phân biệt và đánh giá (real stunts vs. CGI)
Kết luận có sắc thái (action for myself, animation with my family…)
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, mở rộng sang thảo luận về ngành điện ảnh hoặc xu hướng xem phim trực tuyến với lập luận và ví dụ.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Khách du lịch vừa nhận phòng khách sạn, hỏi lễ tân.
key_differences_vi: IM hỏi đủ 3–4 câu đúng dạng.
IH đặt bối cảnh, câu hỏi lịch sự và có câu hỏi điều kiện.
AL tạo chuỗi câu hỏi có logic xuất phát từ nhu cầu cụ thể, dùng câu hỏi gián tiếp tự nhiên.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Không cần hỏi đúng những câu này. Chuẩn bị 6–8 'mẫu câu hỏi' linh hoạt (Could you tell me…, Is it possible to…, I'm wondering if…) dùng được cho mọi tình huống role-play.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Tưởng tượng bạn đang đi du lịch với người thân thật của bạn — nhu cầu của họ sẽ gợi ra câu hỏi tự nhiên.

IM.text: Hello. I just checked in to room 805. Can I ask you some questions? What time is breakfast? Is there a swimming pool in the hotel? Also, what is the Wi-Fi password? And are there any famous places near the hotel? How can I get there? Thank you very much for your help.
demonstrates: Mở đầu đúng tình huống
4 câu hỏi khác nhau, đúng dạng câu hỏi
Kết thúc cảm ơn
IM.next_level: Nói rõ hoàn cảnh (lần đầu đến thành phố, đi với ai), dùng câu hỏi lịch sự đa dạng (Could you…, I was wondering…) và hỏi thêm khi câu trả lời dẫn tới nhu cầu mới.

IH.text: Hi, good evening. I just checked in to room 805, and since it's my first time in this city, I was hoping you could help me with a few things. First of all, could you tell me what time breakfast is served, and is it included in my room rate? Also, I saw a sign for a swimming pool. Is it open in the evening, and do I need to bring my own towel? Another thing, I'd like to do some sightseeing tomorrow. Are there any famous places within walking distance of the hotel? If they're too far to walk, what's the best way to get there? Is it easy to get a taxi from here, or do you recommend a ride-hailing app? Oh, and one last question. Is there a good local restaurant nearby where I can try some traditional food? Thank you so much, that's really helpful.
demonstrates: Đặt bối cảnh hợp lý (first time in this city)
Câu hỏi lịch sự, đa dạng (could you tell me, I was hoping…)
Câu hỏi nối tiếp có điều kiện (If they're too far…)
Ngữ điệu hội thoại tự nhiên (Oh, and one last question)
IH.next_level: Tạo câu hỏi phụ thuộc vào nhu cầu cụ thể (lịch trình, ngân sách, đi cùng trẻ nhỏ) và phản hồi như đang đối thoại thật.

AL.text: Hi there, good evening. I've just checked in—room 805—and I'm hoping you can help me plan a little, because it's my first time here and I'm traveling with my wife and our five-year-old. Let me start with the basics. What time does breakfast start? We're early risers, so I'm wondering if it's possible to eat before six thirty, or if there's something like a grab-and-go option. I also noticed the pool on the fourth floor. Is it suitable for small kids, and is there a lifeguard, or should we keep a closer eye on her? Then, for tomorrow, we'd like to see the old quarter, but I'm not sure how far it is. If it's more than twenty minutes on foot, would you suggest a taxi, or is there a shuttle from the hotel? And since we'll probably be out most of the day, could you recommend a restaurant around there that's family-friendly but still serves proper local food, not just tourist dishes? Finally, just in case, what's the latest time we can ask for a late checkout on Sunday? Thanks a lot—I really appreciate you taking the time.
demonstrates: Đặt bối cảnh cụ thể, câu hỏi xuất phát từ nhu cầu thật
Câu hỏi gián tiếp và điều kiện đa dạng (I'm wondering if…, If it's more than…, would you suggest…)
Chuỗi câu hỏi có logic (cơ bản → hồ bơi → lịch trình → ăn uống → trả phòng)
Lịch sự, tự nhiên như hội thoại thật
AL.next_level: Ở mức luyện tập AL, giữ được sự tự nhiên khi chuyển sang câu 12 (giải quyết vấn đề) — ngôn ngữ thương lượng và đề xuất phương án.

answer_sets.persona_vi: Khách hàng nhận áo khoác đặt online bị sai size và sai màu.
key_differences_vi: IM nêu vấn đề và 2 phương án đơn giản.
IH giải thích có cấu trúc, 3 phương án có điều kiện.
AL lập luận như một cuộc thương lượng thật: bằng chứng, ảnh hưởng, ưu tiên, điều kiện và xác nhận.
answer_sets.not_memorize_vi: Số đơn hàng, Hàn Quốc, màu olive chỉ là chi tiết minh họa. Học khung: tôi là ai → chuyện gì sai → vì sao quan trọng → 2–3 phương án có điều kiện → đề nghị phản hồi.
answer_sets.personalize_vi: Nghĩ về một món đồ bạn thật sự hay mua online; vấn đề nào hợp lý nhất (sai size, hỏng, giao trễ)?

IM.text: Hello, my name is Minh. I ordered a jacket from your store last week. Today I got it, but there is a problem. The size is wrong. I ordered a medium, but you sent a small. Also, the color is different from the picture. It is dark green, not black. Can I exchange it for a black jacket in medium? If you don't have it, can I get a refund? Please call me back. Thank you.
demonstrates: Giới thiệu, nêu vấn đề rõ ràng
2 phương án (đổi / hoàn tiền)
Kết lịch sự
IM.next_level: Giải thích vì sao vấn đề quan trọng với bạn (cần mặc khi nào), đưa 3 phương án có điều kiện và hỏi lại quy trình cụ thể.

IH.text: Hi, my name is Minh, and I'm calling about an order I placed on your website last Monday. The order number is on my receipt if you need it. I received the jacket this morning, but unfortunately there are two problems with it. First, I ordered a medium, but the label says small, and it's really tight on me.
